findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_overnight_cos_pack" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Buy and download the Overnight Chief of Staff Setup Pack ($9 USDC on Base via x402): 5 ready-to-paste bot prompts, an HTML morning-briefing template, and a PDF …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_overnight_cos_pack, endpoint_spot_check · Private data: get_service · Public sink: endpoint_spot_check · Destructive: endpoint_spot_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_overnight_cos_pack, endpoint_spot_check · Private data: get_service · Public sink: endpoint_spot_check · Destructive: endpoint_spot_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
